remote_command:
cd /workspace && mkdir -p out_ehn_box && export ENGINE_COMMIT=842ce612097056482531523bdd0e67191ced9e5e && /workspace/jaxenv/bin/pip install -q 'git+https://github.com/JimGalasyn/jax-solitons' 'git+https://github.com/JimGalasyn/soliton-playground' && cat > leg.sh <<'EOSCRIPT'
set -u
OUT=out_ehn_box
PY=/workspace/jaxenv/bin/python
BOOT=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
if [ -f "$OUT/DONE" ]; then echo "already complete: $(cat $OUT/DONE)"; exit 0; fi
RUNNING=no
if [ -s "$OUT/PID" ]; then
  read -r PBOOT PPID_ < "$OUT/PID" || true
  if [ "$PBOOT" = "$BOOT" ] && kill -0 "$PPID_" 2>/dev/null; then RUNNING=yes; fi
fi
if [ "$RUNNING" = yes ]; then
  echo "REATTACHED to live pid $PPID_ on this box; not relaunching"
else
  RESUME=""
  if [ -f "$OUT/field.npz" ]; then
    if "$PY" -c "import zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile('$OUT/field.npz').namelist()" 2>/dev/null; then
      RESUME="--resume $OUT/field.npz"; echo "RESUMING from $OUT/field.npz"
    else
      echo "DISCARDING $OUT/field.npz: not a readable zip (torn restore)"
      rm -f "$OUT/field.npz"
    fi
  fi
  setsid nohup bash -c "$PY -m jax_solitons.ehn.relax --geom torus --tp 2 --tq 5 --R 64.0 --N 320 --L 256.0 --C 400.0 --U 50 --alpha 0.0001 --beta 2e-3 --cramp 8000 --agrad wrapped --ic screened --steps 36000 --samples 72 --topo-every 1 --det-every 1 --det-timeout 180.0 --save-every 3000 --out out_ehn_box $RESUME ; echo \"exit=\$?\" > $OUT/DONE" > "$OUT/run.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  echo "$BOOT $!" > "$OUT/PID"
  echo "LAUNCHED detached: $(cat $OUT/PID)"
fi
while [ ! -f "$OUT/DONE" ]; do
  read -r PBOOT PPID_ < "$OUT/PID" || true
  if ! kill -0 "$PPID_" 2>/dev/null; then
    sleep 5
    if [ ! -f "$OUT/DONE" ]; then
      echo "payload pid $PPID_ vanished with no DONE marker"; exit 1
    fi
  fi
  sleep 15
done
echo "marker: $(cat $OUT/DONE)"
EOSCRIPT
bash leg.sh
